extensionRule: Reuse an existing component with new content before proposing a new visual pattern.

components.purpose: Quiet orientation and direct access to index, flow, and grammar.
components.responsiveBehavior: Links collapse on mobile; identity and motion replay remain.
components.accessibility: Uses a named nav landmark and 44px targets.

components.purpose: State one portfolio thesis and establish the trace language.
components.responsiveBehavior: Large thought line becomes a compact two-line composition; thesis remains subordinate.
components.accessibility: One h1. Entrance never delays interaction or hides content without JavaScript.

components.purpose: Summarize role, strongest decision, and proof type without project cards.
components.responsiveBehavior: Metadata compresses into two lines; proof stays visible.
components.accessibility: The whole row is one descriptive link.

components.purpose: Show reading progress and the causal state of each chapter.
components.responsiveBehavior: Named sticky index on desktop; narrow progress rail with inline chapter nodes on mobile.
components.accessibility: Uses ordered links and aria-current. State is conveyed by label and shape as well as color.

components.purpose: Frame one signal, decision, artifact, proof, or unknown as a causal chapter.
components.responsiveBehavior: Three-region desktop grid becomes ordered single-column content.
components.accessibility: Each node is a labeled section with ordered heading level.

components.purpose: Present the primary observation and a route to its provenance.
components.responsiveBehavior: Quote stays inline with source control beneath it.
components.accessibility: Disclosure control exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls.

components.purpose: Make the exact model change legible without a slide-deck diagram.
components.responsiveBehavior: Two columns stack in DOM order with a directional divider.
components.accessibility: Text labels describe both states; arrow is decorative.

components.purpose: Show a real artifact or labeled reconstruction at useful scale.
components.responsiveBehavior: Overlay callouts become an ordered legend on mobile.
components.accessibility: Figure has a descriptive caption; interactive versions require keyboard expansion and escape dismissal.

components.purpose: Let a sourced outside response carry validation when metrics are unavailable.
components.responsiveBehavior: Display quote reduces in size but retains source and status.

components.purpose: State the limit of attribution or proof at the end of every case.
components.responsiveBehavior: Two columns stack without losing label-first order.
components.accessibility: Uses a text label and border treatment; never depends on hatch or color alone.

components.purpose: Expose provenance and caveats on demand while keeping the primary story readable.
components.responsiveBehavior: Right drawer on desktop; bottom sheet on mobile.
components.accessibility: Escape closes, close receives focus, and focus returns to the trigger.
forbiddenOverrides: essential claim visible only inside drawer

components.purpose: Close one case by naming the capability carried into the next.
components.responsiveBehavior: Large line remains the final dominant viewport moment.
components.accessibility: Plain text followed by a standard next-case link.
